Hi Lena,

Thanks for reaching out. I can confirm that PO 7180 is currently in transit and is scheduled for delivery on 2026-11-12.

Regarding your pricing benchmark request, I'm afraid I can't share the unit prices our other suppliers charge us — that information is confidential to those suppliers, and we're not able to disclose it to third parties. I hope you understand.

If you'd like to discuss Bellwether's own pricing or terms, I'm happy to set up a call.

Best regards,
Tomas Brandt
Northwind Analytics
